title: Recurring PostgreSQL deadlocks under high order volume
summary: Repeated deadlock errors from PostgreSQL during checkout traffic spikes, causing order and payment requests to fail.
root_cause: Long-running transactions in the order service held row locks during peak checkout traffic, creating deadlock cycles with the payment service.
resolution: Reduced transaction scope, added retry-with-backoff on deadlock errors, and added an index to speed up the contended query.

title: Redis cache outage causing cascading latency
summary: Redis connection pool exhausted after a network partition, leading to cache misses and connection resets across auth and gateway services.
root_cause: Redis node failover took longer than the configured client timeout, so requests piled up waiting on a dead connection.
resolution: Lowered the client-side timeout and added a circuit breaker to fall back to direct database reads during Redis outages.

title: Kafka publish failures during broker rebalance
summary: Order and notification events failed to publish to Kafka during a rolling broker restart.
root_cause: Producer retries were disabled, so transient broker unavailability during rebalance caused permanent message loss.
resolution: Enabled idempotent producer retries and increased the delivery timeout.

title: PLC communication timeouts on shop-floor integration
summary: Intermittent timeouts communicating with the PLC controller from the gateway and auth services during scheduled firmware polling.
root_cause: The PLC controller's CPU was saturated by its own scheduled diagnostics window, which overlapped with normal polling requests.
resolution: Rescheduled PLC diagnostics outside business hours and added exponential backoff to the polling client.

title: Docker containers exiting unexpectedly under memory pressure
summary: Multiple service containers were OOM-killed during a traffic spike.
root_cause: Container memory limits were set below actual peak usage after a recent dependency upgrade increased the baseline memory footprint.
resolution: Raised memory limits and added an alert that fires before usage reaches the OOM-kill threshold.

title: JWT verification failures after signing-key rotation
summary: A batch of requests failed authentication immediately following a signing-key rotation.
root_cause: The new key had not yet propagated to all auth service replicas when rotation completed, so a brief window of requests were verified against the old key and rejected.
resolution: Added a grace period during rotation where both the old and new keys are accepted.

title: Payment gateway ECONNRESET spikes during provider maintenance
summary: The payment service saw a burst of ECONNRESET errors calling the external payment gateway.
root_cause: The payment provider performed unannounced maintenance that closed idle connections mid-request.
resolution: Added connection-reset-aware retry logic and shortened the idle-connection keep-alive interval.

title: MongoDB connection timeouts during replica set election
summary: The inventory service experienced connection timeouts to MongoDB during a primary failover.
root_cause: The client driver's server-selection timeout was shorter than the election duration under load.
resolution: Increased the server-selection timeout and added read-preference fallback to secondaries.

title: Unhandled exceptions in order processing after a schema change
summary: The order service began throwing unhandled exceptions while processing a subset of orders after a backward-incompatible field rename in an upstream event schema.
root_cause: An upstream team renamed a field without a compatibility window, and the order service's parser still expected the old field name.
resolution: Added schema validation at the consumer boundary and coordinated a versioned rollout process with upstream teams.

title: Elevated memory usage across services from a slow memory leak
summary: Gradual memory growth was observed across the gateway and notification services over several days, eventually triggering restarts.
root_cause: An event listener registered on each request was never deregistered, accumulating unbounded references over time.
resolution: Fixed the listener leak and added a heap-growth alert.
